polly_note: MONDAY DECISION REVIEW (2026-08-03). Verdicts below. (1) EN A/B: PROMOTE NEITHER, the null STANDS. I said on Sunday that A leading three weeks running earned a deliberate check rather than a third dismissal, so I ran it. On the full window 06-01..08-02 A is 0.869 percent (117 conv on 13,459) against B 0.812 percent (107 on 13,172), z=+0.51, not significant, threshold comfortably met. On the post-conclusion slice 07-28..08-02, where A's recent lead actually lives, A is 1.331 percent (14 on 1052) against B 0.709 percent (6 on 846), z=+1.32, and by ad content z=+1.53. Neither reaches 1.96 and the slice holds 14 and 6 conversions against a 100 per variant threshold, so it is nowhere near powered. The honest summary: A has led three weeks in the same direction, which is not nothing, but it does not clear significance on any cut and the cumulative z has moved only 0.11 to 0.51 across the whole test. IMPORTANT CAVEAT ON THAT SLICE, WHICH I DO NOT WANT GLOSSED: I chose the 07-28 start date AFTER seeing A pull ahead. A window selected because it looks promising will flatter itself, so its z is optimistically biased and must not be read as a fresh test. If we want this question genuinely settled rather than re-litigated every Monday, the move is to pre-register a new window: fix the start date, fix the endpoint, and commit to the readout before looking. At the observed effect size that needs roughly 2,000 sessions per arm, about one more week at current volume. Recommend deciding whether to do that deliberately, instead of continuing to slice. (2) LOCALIZED IT/DE: NO VERDICT POSSIBLE, and this is insufficient data rather than a null. IT carries 10 conversions and DE carries 1, against a 100 per variant threshold. Nothing about either rate is decidable yet and no pause or promote call is available. (3) DE TRAFFIC IS OFF FOR A FOURTH DAY: 29, 32, 16, 2, 3, 4. Still isolated to the Meta campaign 'CV - Purchases - DE', still needs Ads Manager, still with Lucas. It should be either fixed or formally paused, because a half-dead campaign dribbling 2 to 4 sessions a day keeps accruing denominator against a single conversion and quietly degrades the DE rate. (4) BOUNCE: A 79.5, B 81.8, stable for a third week and still roughly 8 to 10 points above where both sat three weeks ago. Both variants remain locked together, which continues to indicate traffic mix over a page fault. Undiagnosed; I have no channel-level cut that would settle it, and the largest single bucket is still unattributed traffic.

built_not_yet_live.name: German LP v2 - brand-matched, trust-led
built_not_yet_live.note: v2 PUBLISHED 2026-07-30 after Lucas's design feedback on v1. Now uses the real LP design system (navy/gold/cream, Cinzel and Raleway) instead of an approximation, fixes product images that were being cropped out of proportion, drops the 'Recommended for Germany' badge, and rewrites the German with proper umlauts (v1 used ASCII workarounds like 'gross' and 'Laender', which reads cheap to a German reader and was probably much of why it looked wrong). Trust content is built around what a German buyer actually checks before ordering from abroad: ships from the EU with no customs, 4 to 8 working days with tracking, 14-day statutory right of withdrawal, prices marked inkl. MwSt., and Impressum plus Widerrufsbelehrung in the footer. CORRECTION MADE DURING THE BUILD: the first draft listed giropay and Sofortueberweisung as payment methods. Neither is offered. I verified the real set against the live storefront (PayPal, Klarna, SEPA, Visa, Mastercard, Maestro, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay) and removed the invented ones. TWO CLAIMS STILL NEED LUCAS TO CONFIRM BEFORE THIS COULD GO LIVE: whether pay-by-invoice is actually enabled in Klarna (the single strongest German trust lever, currently left off the page because it is unverified), and whether 'ships from the EU, 4 to 8 working days' is accurate. UNDERLYING THESIS STILL UNVERIFIED: the page leads with the Base Game on the assumption Germany wants a lower-risk entry, and the country-by-product split needed to test that is still blocked on Shopify access.
